what: The queue is one flock with no bound on how long a holder keeps it: `loop.sh content-keys-1112 /root/wt/content-keys-1112/exp1.sh` held it for over 15 minutes (ps etimes 925 s) with three lanes queued behind it; my `check --fix` call waited behind it, and each waiting call was moved to the background by the tool after 180 s with no output.
cost: about twenty minutes of waiting, twice
cause: experiments run inside the lock; the brief says to keep each call short but nothing holds a call to it
workaround: wrote docs and agents.json rows while waiting
fix: loop.sh prints who holds the lock and for how long while it waits, and runs the command under `timeout` (ten minutes) so a long run has to be a unit outside the lock
